alice.chen: Hey folks — pinging eng-security for a quick review on this PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4421. It's an authn + audit change required by a compliance reviewer (SOC2). TL;DR: change default token TTL, add audit_logs.source column + migration, and add a backfill script for existing tokens. Need security sign-off and an eng-sre approver. Ideally merged by EOD Wed to make the next compliance delivery.

matthew: I'll take a look today. One quick Q: does the migration expect any service downtime or table locks?

jordan_sre: skimmed the migration — it uses batched updates and an index on token_id, so no long locks. Recommend adding a throttle flag (BATCH_SIZE) and a --dry-run mode to the backfill script. Also add a runbook entry for the backfill run.

alice.chen: thanks — added env BATCH_SIZE and a --dry-run, + included runbook draft here: https://gist.github.com/alice.chen/8f9b2 (runbook includes expected throughput and rollback steps). Migration files now include reversible down() path.

sec-compliance-bot: Automated check: PR touches config defaults. Reminder: any token TTL increase must be documented in compliance notes.

samir.security: I can do the security review. Two immediate concerns: 1) increasing token TTL from 30d -> 90d raises risk — do we have token rotation/refresh policies? 2) audit_logs.source being freeform could leak internal hostnames; prefer enum with limited values (auth-service, admin-console, unknown). Also ensure the migration marks the source provenance.

alice.chen: good points. Updated default to 60d instead of 90d after internal discussion, and added a token rotation note in the PR description (refresh endpoint and client guidance). Changed audit_logs.source to enum with values you suggested, and the backfill tags existing rows as 'unknown' unless provenance can be inferred.

matthew: LGTM on the code changes. One tiny nit in the migration SQL (missing index creation for the new column) — please add to avoid a sequential scan during queries.

alice.chen: added index creation and pushed. Also added a feature flag: feature.auth.token_backfill (off by default) so we can gate the rollout. PR description updated with runbook link and FF instructions.

jordan_sre: I'll run the backfill in staging tomorrow and post timing. @alice.chen please coordinate with oncall for the prod run and flip the FF only during a quiet window.

samir.security: left a small comment about audit log length for the enum column (VARCHAR(64) is fine). Once that's addressed, I'm good to approve for compliance.

alice.chen: fixed varchar length and responded to comment, force-pushed. Re-requesting review.

samir.security: Approved. Please merge when CI is green and coordinate the runbook with oncall.

devops-bot: CI checks passed — all jobs green (unit, integration, migration smoke).

alice.chen: Merging now. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :party_parrot: 

jordan_sre: noted — will post staging run timings and a short post-run note after prod backfill.

(End of thread)
